H-LT2.exploratory_supplement_(not_preregistere: h_lt2_explore.json. Kills from embed/twist/rotpair starts (e.g. gamma 1.25-1.4) have C <= 0.02 once the region is tr W > 1e-2 max and ~1e-3 on tr W > 0.1 max with second-channel weight ~0: tail noise of a scalar soliton plus a zero channel, supporting the claim there. Kills from the random family (gamma 0.75-1.4, both m=2 and m=3) keep C = 0.1-0.5 on tr W > 0.5 max with second-channel weight 0.1-0.4 and pointwise rank 2-3: genuine multi-channel near-maximisers that are NOT a direct sum in one constant basis. Possible explanation (untested): spatially separated pieces with different eigenvector directions are asymptotically decoupled (R ~ L1) but do not commute across x,y, so the 'one constant unitary' wording is too strong. gamma=1.5 control rows are outside the claimed range 1/2<gamma<3/2 (7 of the 59).
